title.value: Historical Binder: Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria, Vol. II

enrichment.summary: Cover sheet of the Rotary International historical binder for the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria (Club No. 3334), volume II. It records that the club was organized on 24 April 1930, admitted on 4 June 1930 with 22 charter members, and sponsored by the Mukden club. A stamp states that club membership in R.I. was terminated on 31 December 1940.
enrichment.notes: Stamp: CLUB MEMBERSHIP IN R.I. TERMINATED DEC 31 1940. The print code at the foot (Oct. '39) dates the blank form, not the entries.

title.value: Table of Contents, 1936-37 and 1937-38

enrichment.summary: Table of contents of the binder volume for the Rotary years 1936-37 and 1937-38: roster of club membership, club officers, financial matters, sample copies of the club publication, an index-card record of items published in the News Letter up to 30 June 1939, and the credential certificates for the 1937 Nice and 1938 San Francisco conventions.
enrichment.notes: 'aao - 10/7/39' read as typist's initials and date in US order (7 October 1939); 10 July 1939 is possible.

The first page lists officers and the board of directors for 1935-36 and 1936-37 and the past presidents since 1930; the following pages give each member's name and nickname, classification, business and business address, private address and date of election.

title.value: Rotary Club of Harbin, 70th Dist. New Officers and Board of Directors 1936-7

enrichment.summary: Typed list of the officers and board of directors of the Rotary Club of Harbin (70th District) for 1936-37: President Koichi Ehara, Vice-President A. E. Hassek, Secretary Tadao Kawasumi, Treasurer Toshio Maeda, Sergeant at Arms Lui-Tai, Correspondence Secretary Yoshio Gundsi, and eight directors.
enrichment.notes: Typescript on thin paper with red pencil marks; undated, year taken from the heading.

title.value: July 1, 1936, Semi-Annual Report of Club Membership and acknowledgment of remittance due Rotary International

recipients.name: Board of Directors of Rotary International

enrichment.summary: Printed semi-annual report form (original copy) on which the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchoukuo, certifies its membership as of 1 July 1936 and the per capita tax and Rotarian subscriptions due to Rotary International, signed by the president and secretary. Stamped as received in Chicago on 29 July 1936.
enrichment.notes: Figures and signatures are handwritten/typed into the form and not reliably captured by OCR.

title.value: Letter from the Rotary Club of Harbin to Rotary International on payment of dues at the subnormal rate of exchange, 3 July 1936

enrichment.summary: The club explains that it owes Rotary International $130.00, equal to ¥261.77 at the normal rate of exchange but costing ¥444.43 on that day, and that it therefore pays ¥261.77 plus half of the difference, in all ¥353.11 or US$103.28. A draft of the Yokohama Specie Bank for that sum is enclosed.
enrichment.notes: Covering letter for the semi-annual report on p. 8. Letter-spaced typescript; amounts should be checked against the image.

title.value: January 1, 1937, Semi-Annual Report of Club Membership and acknowledgment of remittance due Rotary International

recipients.name: Board of Directors of Rotary International

enrichment.summary: Semi-annual report form on which the Rotary Club of Harbin certifies its membership as of 1 January 1937 and the amounts due to Rotary International for per capita tax and subscriptions to The Rotarian, signed by president and secretary.

title.value: Letter from the Rotary Club of Harbin to the Secretary of Rotary International on payment of dues, 14 January 1937

enrichment.summary: The club states that it owes $132.00 ($130.00 semi-annual subscriptions plus $2.00 for identification cards) and, as in July 1936, pays the yen equivalent at the normal rate of exchange plus half of the difference caused by the subnormal rate, enclosing a Yokohama Specie Bank draft.
enrichment.notes: Stamp 'REMITTANCE FOR $ ... sent to cashier by incoming mail'. Amounts partly illegible in OCR.

title.value: The Harbin Rotarian, No. 49, October 31st, 1936

enrichment.summary: Monthly bulletin of the Rotary Club of Harbin with attendance statistics for October 1936 and minutes of the meetings of 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29 October. It reports the farewell to Rotarian Sahara, transferred to Mukden; an address by the architect Y. Endo on architecture in China and Manchuria; the celebration of President Ehara's promotion with a speech by Rotarian Minsky; a talk by Mr. Pedersen on North Manchuria; and a discussion of the poor attendance of Japanese members and of changing the meeting time.

persons.name: O. Terrell
persons.role: Guest, Chi Tung Tobacco Co., Mukden

enrichment.notes: Two-column print; OCR reads across columns on several pages, so the reading order of full_text is unreliable until the pages are re-transcribed. p. 19 (blank reverse) follows.

title.value: The Harbin Rotarian, No. 55, April 30-th, 1937

enrichment.summary: Bulletin of the Rotary Club of Harbin with attendance statistics for April 1937 and minutes of the meetings of 1, 8, 15 and 24 April. It records the visit of Hsinking Rotarian Lee Shao Ken, the return of members Kaufman and Januszovsky after long absences, a talk on Hangchow and Chekiang province, Kaufman's account of his stay in Shanghai, the Family Night held at the Nichiman Club on 24 April, and remarks by Rotarian Ostroumoff on the growth of Rotary from 4000 to 4200 clubs.
enrichment.notes: Receipt stamp on p. 20 not legible at working resolution.

title.value: Items Published in The NEWS LETTER up to 30 June, 1937

enrichment.summary: Backing sheet with a pasted index card listing items about the Harbin club published in Rotary International's weekly News Letter between 1930 and 1933: the club's organization by District Governor Yoneyama, its newly elected officers, a message urging conciliation of difficulties in Manchuria, translations of pamphlets into Russian, a publication issued in Russian, Japanese and English, and an appeal for flood relief contributions.
enrichment.notes: The contents page gives 30 June 1939 for this index, the sheet itself 1937. Card text is small; year column partly misread by OCR (1951-52 for 1931-32).

title.value: Credential Certificate, Rotary International 1937 Convention, Nice, France

enrichment.summary: Credential certificate (Form B) by which the Rotary Club of Harbin names its delegates and alternates to the 1937 Rotary International convention at Nice. K. Ehara and T. Kawasumi are typed in; a proxy is entered by hand. The club reports 37 members and is entitled to one delegate. The reverse prints the relevant articles of the R.I. constitution and by-laws.
enrichment.notes: Handwritten proxy name and his club not confidently read ('T. Ohdaira?, Koriyama?'). The membership date has 'April' struck out and 'Feb.' written above.

title.value: Data for 1937-38 Official Directory. Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchoukuo

enrichment.summary: Duplicate of the club's return for the 1937-38 Official Directory: meetings on Thursdays at 1.00 at the Nichiman Club; president for 1937-38 Kawamura (exchange banking, Yokohama Specie Bank); secretary Yoshio Gundsi (economic investigation, Harbin Railway Directorate); 35 members; club headquarters at the Nichiman Club, 1 Nagorny str., Harbin.
enrichment.notes: The PDF's own text layer is empty for this page. President's given name unclear in the typescript (Shichiro?).

title.value: Charter certificate of the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria, Club No. 3334

dates.as_written: this fourth day of June, Anno Domini 1930

enrichment.summary: Engraved charter certifying that the Rotary Club of Harbin, Manchuria, is a duly elected member of Rotary International as Club No. 3334, dated 4 June 1930 and signed by the president and secretary of Rotary International. It is stamped three times 'CANCELED - This charter is', each stamp signed by the secretary, Chesley R. Perry.
